D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Nikki Budzinski leads by 18.3 in the forecast and wins 99% of simulations. The cushion is about 50,405 votes; a one point swing is about 1,378 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +10.6 and D +25.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$2.9M cash against $25K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.

National tide: Gallup party identification moved from Republicans 48 Democrats 45 in the third quarter of 2024 to Democrats 50 Republicans 39 in the third quarter of 2026, 14 points toward the Democrats.

R.t: Jeff Wilson trails by 18.3 and wins 1% of simulations. Closing it takes about 25,203 voters switching sides, or 50,405 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +25.8 and D +10.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$25K cash against $2.9M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
